name: 20851 · Rockville, MD
findings: ZIP 20851 (Rockville) has 46 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20851 (Rockville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 20851 (Rockville) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 8 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.
